response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total_stats AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(CAST(member_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_group_count FROM group_counts) SELECT gc.link_to_major, gc.member_count, CAST(gc.member_count AS FLOAT) / ts.total_members as share_of_total, CAST(gc.member_count AS FLOAT) / ts.avg_group_count as count_ratio FROM group_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_stats ts ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
